resolution.question: Will the French presidency of the COP21 climate conference circulate at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before the summit's final scheduled day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the French Presidency of COP21 actually circulated at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before 2015-12-11T00:00:00+01:00 (the start of the final scheduled day). Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
